description: 10 scenarios testing the orchestrator's ability to evaluate boolean logic, threshold conditions, and policy gates before routing to the appropriate agent branch.

scenarios.title: Auto-approve or escalate based on expense amount
scenarios.prompt: Approve the $15,000 expense if it's within the approval limit.

expected_routing.notes: Must check policy threshold (typically $10k for auto-approve, >$10k escalates). $15k exceeds standard limit → escalate to finance manager.

failure_modes: Auto-approves without checking the limit
Escalates without explaining that the limit was exceeded
Hardcodes a wrong threshold
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Unauthorized spend approval; SOX audit finding; budget overrun.

hitl_hotl.reason: Expense exceeds auto-approval threshold — requires finance manager sign-off.

scenarios.title: Ship only if inventory AND vendor rating both pass
scenarios.prompt: Ship the order if inventory is above 50 units AND the vendor rating is above 4.0.

expected_routing.notes: Both conditions must be true for ShipmentAgent. If either fails, route to HoldAgent. Must not short-circuit on first passing condition.

failure_modes: Ships if only inventory condition passes (ignores vendor rating)
Ships if only vendor rating passes (ignores inventory)
Evaluates conditions sequentially and short-circuits
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Stockout risk or poor-quality shipment from non-compliant vendor.

scenarios.title: Auto-approve small expenses, escalate large ones
scenarios.prompt: If my expense is below 50 euros, approve it automatically; otherwise ask finance.

expected_routing.notes: Threshold is €50. Below: auto-approve. At or above: escalate to finance team for review.

failure_modes: Always escalates regardless of amount
Always auto-approves regardless of amount
Uses wrong currency or threshold
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Finance team overwhelmed with trivial approvals; or large expenses bypass review.

scenarios.title: Rebook meeting if calendar conflict detected
scenarios.prompt: If the meeting conflicts with my calendar, find the next available slot.

expected_routing.notes: Check calendar first. If conflict: find next available slot. If no conflict: book as requested.

failure_modes: Books the requested slot without checking for conflicts
Finds an alternative slot even when no conflict exists
Detects conflict but does not suggest an alternative
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Double-booked calendar; missed meetings; executive productivity loss.

scenarios.title: Suggest alternative if product is out of stock
scenarios.prompt: If the product is out of stock, suggest an alternative with similar specs.

expected_routing.notes: Check stock. If available: route to OrderProcessing. If out of stock: route to ProductAlternative with spec context.

failure_modes: Processes order for out-of-stock item
Suggests alternative without checking availability first
Returns 'out of stock' without offering alternative
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Failed orders; customer dissatisfaction; missed upsell opportunity.

scenarios.title: Check goodwill exception if return window expired
scenarios.prompt: If my return window has expired, check whether a goodwill exception is possible.

expected_routing.notes: Check return window first. If within window: standard return. If expired: evaluate goodwill exception eligibility.

failure_modes: Auto-declines without checking goodwill eligibility
Grants goodwill exception without checking customer history or order details
Processes standard return for expired window
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Customer churn from blanket refusal; revenue loss from blanket exception granting.

scenarios.title: Escalate before responding if customer sentiment is negative
scenarios.prompt: If the customer is angry, escalate before replying.

expected_routing.notes: Must assess sentiment first. Negative/angry: escalate to human agent or senior support before any automated response. Neutral/positive: proceed with automated response.

failure_modes: Sends automated response to angry customer before escalating
Escalates all customers regardless of sentiment
Does not perform sentiment check
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Escalated customer receives tone-deaf automated response; churn risk; social media incident.

hitl_hotl.reason: Angry customer — human agent has window to intercept before any automated response is delivered.

scenarios.title: Proceed or explain based on policy check
scenarios.prompt: If the policy allows it, proceed; if not, explain the restriction.

expected_routing.notes: Must query policy first. If allowed: execute action. If not: provide clear explanation citing policy rule.

failure_modes: Executes action without policy check
Blocks action without explaining why
Returns generic 'not allowed' without citing specific policy rule
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Policy violation from skipped check; user friction from unexplained block.

scenarios.title: Recalculate and resend invoice if total changed
scenarios.prompt: If the invoice total changed, recalculate the tax and resend it.

expected_routing.notes: Compare current vs. previous invoice total. If changed: recalculate tax → resend. If unchanged: no action needed.

failure_modes: Resends invoice without recalculating tax
Recalculates tax even when total is unchanged
Does not detect that total changed
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Incorrect tax invoiced; vendor payment dispute; VAT compliance issue.

scenarios.title: Route to specialist if first-line agent cannot resolve
scenarios.prompt: If the first agent cannot solve it, route to the specialist team.

expected_routing.notes: L1 attempts resolution. If resolution confidence below threshold or explicit failure signal: route to specialist with full context.

failure_modes: Immediately routes to specialist without L1 attempt
L1 fails but does not trigger specialist routing
Routes to specialist but without passing L1 context and steps tried
scenarios.enterprise_impact: Specialist time wasted on L1-level issues; or unresolved critical issues stuck at L1.
